r7-genuineness.title: F12 genuineness verification (handoff's 6-point close criteria)
r7-genuineness.imperative: Independently verify: (1) discriminating test genuinely constructs different scenarios asserting different verdicts; (2) F12_AGREEMENT_THRESHOLD + scale constants chosen before the real run, principled rationale not reverse-engineered; (3) k-mismatch-as-automatic-FAIL is a pre-declared rule from g3-implement-handoff.md, implemented as float(inf) not swallowed; (4) independently re-run scripts/f12_held_out_stability.py against the real DB and confirm identical verdict/per-split k_a/k_b/circuit membership; (5) property_mixture.py has ZERO diff from this gate; (6) DB opened read-only, never written.
r7-genuineness.finding: (1) Discriminating test is genuine: test_same_generator_all_circuits_gives_pass uses 12 synthetic circuits ALL drawing from the identical 2-blob generator (different random draws only) -> asserts headline_verdict=='PASS', n_pass==n_splits==5. test_shifted_generator_two_circuits_gives_fail uses exactly 2 circuit names from generators shifted by 20x each scale constant (1000m radius / 10g lateral-g) -- with only 2 names, the 50/50 split ALWAYS puts exactly one full circuit per half on every seed, deterministically guaranteeing separation -> asserts headline_verdict=='FAIL', n_pass==0, max_statistic>threshold. Different constructions, different assertions, neither would pass under the other's scenario -- genuinely discriminating, not hollow. (2) Threshold/scales pre-registered before the real run: docstring rationale is pure domain-magnitude reasoning (hairpin ~15-25m vs medium corner ~60-90m for RADIUS_SCALE_M; ~1.0g vs ~2.0g+ for LATERAL_G_SCALE) with no reference to grip_bin_obs data. Corroborated by file mtimes: mixture_stability.py last modified 2026-07-17 22:14:12 -07:00 and NOT touched since (confirmed current mtime unchanged after all my re-runs); both real-data runs happened strictly after that (implement-result.md's first transcript run at 22:29:59 -07:00, the committed artifact's run at 23:16:39 -07:00) -- the constants could not have been reverse-engineered from a result that didn't exist yet when the file was last written, and stayed frozen across both runs (which independently reproduced the identical verdict, ruling out any inter-run tuning). (3) k-mismatch-as-automatic-FAIL is pre-declared: g3-implement-handoff.md's hungarian_match close criterion states verbatim '...treated as float("inf") / an automatic FAIL for that split, NOT an error... document this explicitly' -- this is upstream Commander authority, not implementer improvisation. Code implements it exactly: component_agreement_stat's first line is 'if fit_a.k != fit_b.k: return float("inf")', never swallowed -- propagates cleanly through SplitResult.statistic, StabilityResult.mean/max_statistic (np.mean/np.max correctly propagate inf), and passed=statistic<threshold correctly evaluates False. (4) Real-data run independently reproduced by this review (see r3-evidence) -- byte-identical verdict/per-split k_a,k_b/circuit membership. (5) property_mixture.py zero diff from this gate confirmed (see r2-scope: content match + mtime ordering placing it strictly in gate 2's window, before gate 3's). (6) DB read-only confirmed independently (see r3-evidence: write attempt correctly rejected). All 6 close-criteria items verified genuine -- no evidence of fabrication, post-hoc tuning, or rule-swallowing.
